description: This file provides configuration helpers for authentication, including environment variable parsing, validation, and tenant resolution logic.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Normalizes environment variable values by converting undefined or null to empty string and trimming whitespace.

methods.name: isUrlSafeShortBase64
methods.description: Validates if a string is URL-safe base64 without padding, typically 20-44 characters long.

methods.name: getTenantSaltConfig
methods.description: Retrieves and validates the tenant salt configuration from environment variables.

methods.name: getJwtSecretConfig
methods.description: Retrieves and assesses the JWT secret from environment variables.

methods.name: getPasswordSaltConfig
methods.description: Retrieves and validates the password salt from environment variables.

methods.name: tenantFromHost
methods.description: Extracts the tenant identifier from a host header, typically the left-most subdomain.

methods.name: getTenantConfig
methods.description: Provides tenant resolution and allowlist/mapping validation based on environment variables and request data.
